title: ScheduledTaskContribution
description: A code-declared periodic task: Spring `@Scheduled`, Quartz `Job`, Celery `@app.task` with beat schedule, cron-style annotation, NestJS `@Cron`, etc. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `SpringScanKS` today; future framework-specific KSs.

taskSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the scheduled method / function / job class. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). E.g. Quartz job-data map, Celery `routing_key`, k8s `concurrencyPolicy`.
